JOB: Analyst, Commercial Logistics
COMPANY: Domtar
SOURCE: LinkedIn, Montreal QC, 2026-10-16 (from the progress presentation, trimmed)

The location in Montreal, Quebec, Canada, is seeking talent to fill the position of Analyst, Commercial Logistics. This job is full-time permanent.
Your challenges
You will act as the go-to expert for tools, data, and analysis within the commercial logistics team. In this capacity, you will:
Support specialists and the logistics manager in producing cost-benefit analysis
Actively participate in identifying and implementing logistics chain optimization initiatives
Ensure the availability, reliability, and integrity of logistics data used in commercial decisions
Play a key role in transformation and improvement projects related to systems and analytical tools
Key responsibilities
More specifically, your focus will include the following:
Produce and automate cost-benefit analyses to support commercial decisions (transportation, routing, contracts)
Support logistics specialists in negotiations by providing reliable data and comparative scenarios
Structure data to improve the speed and quality of decision-making
Ensure data integrity, consistency, and availability across systems (ERP, analytical files)
Implement and maintain data quality controls
Be responsible for managing transportation rates and updating them in the relevant tools
Review, standardize, and continuously improve analytical files and tools (Excel, Power BI, databases)
Automate manual processes to improve operational efficiency
Reduce risks related to errors and improve data traceability

Lead or contribute to projects aimed at improving systems and analytical processes (3–5 month horizon)
Act as a liaison between business teams and IT teams
Identify and propose logistics chain optimization initiatives (costs, lead times, routing)
Your team
Reporting to the Commercial Logistics Manager, you will join a results-driven team where innovation, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement are highly valued.
Your profile
University degree in computer science, analytics, information systems, logistics, or a related field
3 to 5 years of experience in data analysis, tool development, or systems improvement
Good understanding of logistics operations (rail, truck, or marine transportation is a strong asset)
Experience with ERP systems and analytical tools (advanced Excel, Power BI, SQL or equivalent)
Strong interest in process optimization and automation
Your skills
Excellent analytical and data-driven mindset
Ability to translate business needs into technical and analytical solutions
High level of rigor in data management and validation
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under tight deadlines
Strong ability to influence and collaborate with cross-functional teams
Excellent communication skills (French and English)
Initiative and leadership in transformation projects
